arctic.en: Was it: a) the Arctic, b) Antarctica, or c) the top of Mount Everest?
arctic.zh: 是：a) 北极，b) 南极，还是 c) 珠穆朗玛峰顶？

arctic.en: Canada also has the Arctic, which could really change due to climate change.
arctic.zh: 加拿大还拥有北极地区，该地区可能会因气候变化而发生剧烈改变。

arctic.en: Professor Gunhild Sætren lives on the icy island of Svalbard, 800 miles inside the Arctic Circle.
arctic.zh: Gunhild Sætren 教授住在冰天雪地的斯瓦尔巴群岛，这里位于北极圈内800英里处。

arctic.en: It stretches from the Atlantic Ocean to the Pacific, and all the way north to the Arctic.
arctic.zh: 它从大西洋一直延伸到太平洋，并一路向北直抵北极。

arctic.en: In the Arctic, dogs made human life possible in places that would otherwise have been completely uninhabitable.
arctic.zh: 在北极，狗让人类在原本完全不适合居住的地方得以生存。

argue.en: The government has generally defended these policies by arguing that Singapore needs its stability.
argue.zh: 政府通常通过辩称新加坡需要稳定性来为这些政策辩护。

argue.en: But the critics weren’t having it. They argued that DOGE’s savings were wildly exaggerated.
argue.zh: 但批评人士并不买账。他们认为 DOGE 节省的资金被严重夸大了。

argue.en: It began in the 1930s, but many historians argue that it started on October 29th, 1929.
argue.zh: 它始于 20 世纪 30 年代，但许多历史学家认为它始于 1929 年 10 月 29 日。

argue.en: Domestic abuse charities have argued that the show makes light of violence in the home.
argue.zh: 家庭虐待慈善机构认为，该节目将家庭暴力轻描淡写。

argue.en: Governments and companies often argue that surveillance exists for practical and safety reasons.
argue.zh: 政府和公司经常辩称，监控的存在是出于实际和安全原因。

artificial.en: Montreal has become a place recognized for its aerospace and artificial intelligence industries.
artificial.zh: 蒙特利尔已成为一个以航空航天和人工智能产业闻名的城市。

artificial.en: His long-term impact can be seen across computer science, artificial intelligence, and cryptography.
artificial.zh: 他长期的深远影响遍及计算机科学、人工智能和密码学。

artificial.en: But increasingly, this work is now done using artificial intelligence, or AI.
artificial.zh: 但现在，这项工作越来越多地开始使用人工智能，也就是AI来完成。

artificial.en: And he asked questions about machines that still shape how we think about artificial intelligence today.
artificial.zh: 并且，他关于机器的种种思考，至今仍在塑造着我们对人工智能的理解。

artificial.en: And now with the rapid growth of artificial intelligence, we face an even more complex challenge.
artificial.zh: 现在，随着人工智能的飞速发展，我们面临着更加复杂的挑战。

artistic.en: But I have a fixed mindset in things like my musical and artistic ability.
artistic.zh: 但在音乐和艺术能力等方面，我有着固定型思维。

artistic.en: Yes, artistic routines are done upside down, underwater, without oxygen.
artistic.zh: 是的，花样游泳的成套动作是在水下、倒立且缺氧的情况下完成的。

artistic.en: In artistic swimming, athletes dance underwater while holding their breath!
artistic.zh: 在花样游泳中，运动员要在憋气的同时在水下跳舞！

arouse.en: Aroused means feel a strong emotion like anger.
arouse.zh: Aroused 意思是感受到强烈的情绪，比如愤怒。

arouse.en: Paul thinks we should take time to calm down when we feel aroused, which here means to feel anger or strong disagreement.
arouse.zh: Paul 认为，当我们感到 aroused（在这里意为感到愤怒或强烈的异议）时，应该花时间冷静下来。

architect.en: Its key architect was a man named Edwin Chadwick, who was a follower of the philosopher Jeremy Bentham.
architect.zh: 它的主要策划者是一个名叫 Edwin Chadwick 的人，他是哲学家 Jeremy Bentham 的追随者。

architect.en: They were introduced by Danish architect Carl Theodor Sorensen.
architect.zh: 它们是由丹麦建筑师Carl Theodor Sorensen引入的。

architect.en: Under his rule, Berlin began to attract philosophers and artists and architects from across Prussia, across the modern day Germany, and across Europe.
architect.zh: 在他的统治下，柏林开始吸引来自普鲁士各地、现代德国各地以及全欧洲的哲学家、艺术家和建筑师。

architect.en: Now, there are those who criticised and still criticise his methods, but it is hard to argue about his effectiveness as the primary architect of the Turkey that exists today.
architect.zh: 现在，确实有人过去和现在都在批评他的方法，但很难否认他作为当今土耳其主要缔造者的效率。

architect.en: The man on the stand is Adolf Eichmann. Eichmann had been one of the central architects of the Holocaust, the Nazi programme to murder every Jewish person in Europe.
architect.zh: 站在被告席上的是阿道夫·艾希曼(Adolf Eichmann)。艾希曼曾是大屠杀的核心策划者之一，大屠杀是纳粹企图杀害欧洲每一个犹太人的计划。

arise.en: This was a radical idea. It explained how new species could arise.
arise.zh: 这是一个激进的想法。它解释了新物种是如何产生的。

arise.en: Again, the question arose: Why would these closely related animals live in different regions and have slightly different appearances?
arise.zh: 问题再次出现：为什么这些亲缘关系密切的动物会生活在不同的地区，并且外观略有不同？

arise.en: Well, we know for sure that it does tend to arise from puberty onwards, so the biggest cohort of patients is in the teenage age group.
arise.zh: 嗯，我们确定的是它往往从青春期开始出现，所以最大的患者群体是青少年年龄段。

arise.en: They are still in Ukraine, they are still in Africa, they are still in the Middle East, and still often operate in this grey zone: part Private Military Company, part state actor, and able to shift between the two when the need arises.
arise.zh: 他们仍在乌克兰，仍在非洲，仍在中东，并且仍然经常在这个灰色地带运作：部分是私人军事公司，部分是国家行为体，能够在需要时在两者之间切换。

architecture.en: It combines elements of Islamic, Persian, Indian, and Central Asian architecture.
architecture.zh: 它融合了伊斯兰、波斯、印度和中亚建筑的元素。

architecture.en: Those big apartment blocks and socialist architecture designed to symbolize communist power and communist modernization.
architecture.zh: 那些大型公寓楼和社会主义建筑旨在象征共产主义的力量与现代化。

architecture.en: As a result, Berlin’s architecture and life began to flourish.
architecture.zh: 因此，柏林的建筑和生活开始繁荣起来。

architecture.en: Egyptian civilization is famous for its architecture, especially the pyramids.
architecture.zh: 埃及文明以其建筑闻名于世，尤其是金字塔。

architecture.en: But their architecture reveals a high level of social organization.
architecture.zh: 但他们的建筑展现了高度的社会组织能力。

arrest.en: The reserve army would have arrested the supposedly “disloyal” elements within the Nazi party.
arrest.zh: 后备军本会逮捕纳粹党内所谓的“不忠”分子。

arrest.en: What they didn’t know was that their participation would begin with a surprise arrest.
arrest.zh: 他们不知道的是，自己的参与将以一场突如其来的“逮捕”拉开序幕。

arrest.en: Whether they feared arrest or were seeking military support from abroad, historians still debate.
arrest.zh: 历史学家们至今仍在争论他们是因为害怕被捕，还是为了在国外寻求军事支持。

arrest.en: In 1952, he was arrested and convicted for having a relationship with another man.
arrest.zh: 1952 年，他因与另一名男子保持恋爱关系而被捕并定罪。

arrest.en: Tanks rolled into Cairo, President Morsi was arrested, and an interim government was set up.
arrest.zh: 坦克驶入开罗，Morsi 总统被捕，过渡政府宣告成立。

arbitrary.en: The important idea there is not the exact modern mechanism, but the principle behind it: that justice should not simply be the arbitrary will of the ruler.
arbitrary.zh: 这里重要的并不是那套具体的现代机制，而是它背后的原则：正义不应该仅仅是统治者的一意孤行。

arithmetic.en: This isn’t just speculation or financial engineering, it’s basic arithmetic.
arithmetic.zh: 这不仅仅是投机或是金融工程，这是基本的算术。

arithmetic.en: He was off-the-charts intelligent. By the age of six, Ted was doing complex arithmetic in his head.
arithmetic.zh: 他的智商高得离谱。六岁时，泰德就能在脑海里做复杂的算术。

arithmetic.en: And once the young man had mastered those, he would move on to the quadrivium: arithmetic, geometry, music, and astronomy.
arithmetic.zh: 一旦年轻人掌握了这些，他就会进入“四艺”：算术、几何、音乐和天文学。

arc.en: I’ll review it myself, spend a couple more hours making changes, and I’ll also paste the entire thing into two or three different AI tools and ask them to do everything from fact-checking to grammar checking, and to give me feedback on the narrative arc, things that I’ve missed, and so on.
arc.zh: 我会自己审阅，再花几个小时进行修改，我还会把整个内容粘贴到两三个不同的 AI 工具中，让它们进行从事实核查到语法检查的所有工作，并对叙事结构、我遗漏的内容等提供反馈。

arch.en: The Romans had advanced engineering techniques… forms of concrete that are just as effective as modern concrete, arches, different types of support systems.
arch.zh: 罗马人拥有先进的工程技术……其混凝土配方与现代混凝土一样有效，还有拱门和不同类型的支撑系统。
